summary: Frontend-only verification of the mobile scroll-down arrow centering + reduced gap fix on Home.jsx. All 4 requested checks PASS. Mobile (390x844): hero-scroll-down bounding box = {x:0, width:390} -> center_x=195.0 (exactly centered, within 10px tolerance). Gap between bottom of arrow (y+h=907.24) and top of upcoming-events-section (y=930.17) = 22.93px, well below the 90px threshold (was ~200px before fix). Desktop (1920x800): arrow center_x=960.0 (perfectly centered), events section still positioned at y=964 with expected padding. Regression: /admin redirects to /admin/login (works), /il-club renders all 5 zone-* testids (zone-arco, zone-backthestage, zone-riva-deck, zone-seaview, zone-artist-area), /shop lists 6 product-cards, and all Home data-testid selectors present (hero-section, hero-title, upcoming-events-section, location-section, club-preview-section, shop-preview-section, faq-section). No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Some 401 console errors observed on public pages (Failed to load resource 401) - likely an authenticated endpoint being called without token from a public page. Non-blocking but should be investigated by main agent to reduce noise / avoid unnecessary calls.
